none: PAS CAM-26C8F8: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ FL IVL CONSTANTIVS NOB C

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. AD330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers, two standards. Mint is unknown. Obverse shows Laureate draped bust right. Obverse legend reads FL IVL CONSTANTIVS NOB C. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is very fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.11g, diameter is 16.9mm
